local: With joyful hearts we pledge to thee
Our loyalty and love and vow
english: With joyful hearts we pledge to thee
Our loyalty and love and vow

local: Our faith will see us through.
May peace reign from shore to shore,
And God bless and keep us true.
english: Our faith will see us through.
May peace reign from shore to shore,
And God bless and keep us true.

local: Hairoun, Our fair and blessed Isle,
Your mountains high, so clear and green,
Are home to me, though I may stray,
english: Hairoun, Our fair and blessed Isle,
Your mountains high, so clear and green,
Are home to me, though I may stray,

local: Upon their seas and golden sands
english: Upon their seas and golden sands
